plugins.name: build-fleet
plugins.description: Spec-driven multi-agent software house. A product tier (PLAN → PLAN_REVIEW → PLAN_FINALIZE → DEVELOPING, human-ratified) above a per-feature SPEC → REVIEW → FINALIZE → BUILD → CHANGE_REVIEW → HANDOFF machine. Features inherit a binding stack-of-record + per-feature intent; hook-enforced gates, dynamic-workflow adversarial review + plan interrogation, tests-first fan-out builds, three-tier routing, a backlog DEVELOPING loop, and headless orchestrator support.
